shortDescription: China is expanding 5G use across manufacturing and has built more than 26,000 private industrial 5G networks nationwide, while 6G testing advances, China Central Television reported Saturday, according to Bloomberg.

title: China Has Built More Than 26,000 Industrial 5G Networks as 6G Testing Advances
